New Orleans Saints Executive Vice President/General Manager Mickey Loomis announced today that the club has re-signed CB Decamerion Richardson (pronounced De-cam-ree-ON), terminated the contract of LS Cal Adomitis, waived CB Jayden Price and WR Brock Rechsteiner (was on Reserve/Suspended by Commissioner) and terminated the practice squad contracts of RB Ulysses Bentley and WR Trey Palmer
